articles.title: Ethereum researchers drop faster blocks to race toward quantum defenses in 2027
articles.snippet: Ethlabs wants quantum-resistant accounts targeted for next year, even if wallet holders still have to switch signing methods themselves.

articles.title: MSCI confirms Strategy’s removal from indexes at end of November
articles.snippet: Strategy, Metaplanet and Upexi are marked for deletion in MSCI’s final list, with changes taking effect after the Nov. 30 close.

articles.title: Tether's Tiny AI Agent Beats Models 2.5 Times Its Size at Controlling Your Phone
articles.snippet: BotPsy packs 800 million parameters into an AI assistant designed to manage everyday tasks locally, outperforming larger rivals as Tether expands its push into decentralized artificial intelligence.
